target: Five annual regular-season scrimmage-snap counts and games with recorded snaps; not games started

validation.status: fit-only; no independent pre2018 chronological test possible
validation.reason: 2012 snap source is header-only. Only2013 has all five annual outcomes observable before2018 draft.
validation.samplingPolicy: Condition within broad position on rookieRole using a pooled calibrated rookie-role probability if both strata exist; otherwise use position-wide donors. Draw one whole five-year vector.
validation.specialists: ST scrimmage snaps are not a specialist quality metric; do not condition on scrimmage role or infer specialist skill.
validation.uncertainty: Empirical donor variation is conditional on one cohort and observed opportunity; it does not include full parameter or model uncertainty.

limitations: Known-ID selection bias; unknown identities excluded.
No independent strict2018 chronological validation and only one donor cohort.
Actual opportunity, injuries, coaching and roster context are confounded in donor outcomes.
Games count positive recorded snaps, not official credited appearances or starts.
Future17-game seasons require an explicit exposure policy; no silent rescaling is empirically validated.
No causal mapping from snaps to team wins or value is identified.
Whole trajectory sampling preserves donor correlations but not causal context or unobserved talent.
